rationale.edition: Every changed path is open-source: src/promql/*, src/promql_service/*, src/config/*, web/src/** and tests/ui-testing/** (plus a translations state file). None live under enterprise-owned directories (enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/), and there are no enterprise keywords (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/sensitive-data/logo-management) in the paths, so this is an OSS change.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. The trigger comment and feature hint are empty (no tests-added label or skip request), and the change is user-facing: it adds exemplar markers, toggles, hover cards and click-to-trace interactions to dashboard panels and the metrics explorer, not docs/CI/comment-only edits.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted because the change adds real UI behavior a user exercises: drawing one exemplar marker per in-window exemplar on panel charts, a header toggle that overrides without saving, a hover card, marker click opening a span, and a metrics-explorer card toggle that shows/hides exemplars on a heatmap. These flows need browser verification.
rationale.area: The bulk of new UI lives under web/src/components/dashboards/ (ExemplarCard, ExemplarToggle, ExemplarMarkerList, ChartRenderer) and web/src/composables/dashboard/use*Exemplar*, with sibling specs in tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Dashboards/. The metrics-explorer side (web/src/composables/metrics/useMetricsExplorerExemplars.ts, MetricCard.vue) is a secondary surface and has its own sibling spec under Metrics/.
rationale.group: The primary spec (dashboard-exemplars.spec.js) is chart-rendering/interaction work, matching the Dashboards-Charts shard whose run_files already carry chart specs (custom-charts, geoMap, maps, multi-y-axis). The secondary metrics-explorer-exemplars.spec.js belongs to the Metrics shard and should be handled there.
rationale.existing_tests: Yes — the diff already adds two Playwright E2E specs: tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Dashboards/dashboard-exemplars.spec.js and tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Metrics/metrics-explorer-exemplars.spec.js, plus a tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/utils/exemplar-fixtures.js helper. These cover the new exemplar feature directly, so the Architect should enhance/extend them (route = enhance). The many changed web/src/**/*.spec.ts files are Vitest unit tests, which are not E2E coverage and do not count toward this flag.
